privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must create three specific routines in wger. Phase 1: 'Phase 1 - Anatomical Adaptation' (Weeks 1-4: Movement quality and work capacity foundation) with 'Upper Body Foundations' (Mon) and 'Lower Body Foundations' (Thu). Phase 2: 'Phase 2 - Maximal Strength' (Weeks 5-8: Heavy compound lifts for peak force production) with 'Heavy Upper' (Tue) and 'Heavy Lower' (Fri). Phase 3: 'Phase 3 - Power Development' (Weeks 9-12: Explosive movements and sport-specific power) with 'Explosive Upper' (Mon) and 'Explosive Lower' (Wed). All strings must match exactly.
